messages:
maria_p: Quick heads-up — we need to lock the log retention tiering + cost allocation and how it interacts with customer key integration before next-quarter roadmap.
devon: Ack. Is this about defaults or enterprise-only toggles?
maria_p: Enterprise-only toggle. Proposal: three retention tiers (30d / 90d / 365d), cold-archive option (>365d), and a per-tenant legal-hold flag that overrides deletion.
samir: Important: if a tenant uses their own KMS (customer-managed keys), we cant index or search plaintext logs unless we re-encrypt or hold a second copy. That has cost and compliance implications.
alex: +1. We should decide billing model: simple per-GB-month for storage + per-export fee for evidence packs. Also factor in indexing cpu/infra as premium add-on.
jess_security: SOC2/ISO need: ability to produce an evidence bundle (audit logs, integrity receipts, key handshakes) within SLA. We need acceptance criteria for that.
devon: Operational question — for customer-managed keys, do we accept a key-wrapping handshake to allow ephemeral search tokens, or do we offer a separate "indexed copy" service that the customer can opt into?
samir: Tech options: (a) proxy search requests that decrypt on the fly (requires KMS calls and latency), (b) re-encrypt an indexed mirror under our key (requires consent & policy), (c) keep encrypted and provide raw exports only. Each has cost + security tradeoffs.
alex: From billing POV, option (b) should carry a premium & contract language. Option (a) might be included but will hit latency SLOs — need limits.
maria_p: Draft acceptance criteria Im thinking of (short):
```
- Support retention tiers: 30d/90d/365d + cold-archive
- Legal-hold toggle per-tenant that pauses deletions
- Evidence export: CSV + JSON manifests within 24h; full SOC2 pack within 72h
- For customer-managed keys: explicit opt-in for indexed copy; otherwise raw encrypted exports only
- SLA: retrieval for warm-tier < 2h, archive retrieval < 24h
- Audit trail for every key handshake and export (signed)
```
alex: That looks good. Add meter labels: storage_gb, indexed_gb, export_count, export_gb. Those will feed billing and cost reports.
jess_security: Also require a threat model doc for re-encryption path and an HSM/KMS audit of handshake flow. Compliance needs review before GA.
devon: For implementation, well need work items: retention service (delete pipeline + holds), export pipeline (+manifest signer), indexed pipeline (+consent flow), billing tagging. I can break into tickets once spec exists.
maria_p: Action items:
- Ill write spec draft (retention matrix + acceptance criteria) by EOD Friday
- @devon to sketch infra tasks + rough tickets by Mon
- @samir to propose secure patterns for BYOK/indexing and estimate perf/cost
- @jess_security to list compliance gates and evidence checklist
- @alex to propose billing metrics and draft pricing delta for indexed mirror
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Retention + KMS options triage" Thu 10:00 (30m) — invites sent to participants.
alex: Can we add a short customer-facing summary for sales? Theyll need clear language about what "indexed copy" means and pricing.
maria_p: Yup — will include a one-paragraph customer blurb in the spec. Thanks everyone, see notes in the doc once I post the PR.
